# LJ Link

> Free, open-source app (Eclipse Public License 2.0) for lighting jockeys (LJs) in clubs, at festivals and at events. It shows every DJ deck live – waveforms, position, hot cues, memory cues, loops, beat grid, BPM and key – from Pioneer DJ players (Pro DJ Link) and Denon DJ players (StageLinQ), and sends the BPM to grandMA2 and grandMA3 (and, as a beta, to a Wolfmix over Ableton Link or every beat over OS2L), so no tap tempo is needed. macOS and Windows.

- Passive: it only listens and sends no commands to the DJ gear. No cloud, no telemetry.
- Pioneer and Denon at the same time; devices are added and removed automatically.
- Any tablet, phone or second screen in the network can open the same view.
- Older gear works too, not only CDJ-3000 and DJM-A9: every Pioneer player with a LINK port sends its tempo over Pro DJ Link. CDJ-2000NXS, CDJ-900NXS, XDJ-1000, XDJ-700 and DJM-900NXS are expected to work (not tested yet).
- Tested: CDJ-3000, CDJ-2000NXS2, DJM-2000NXS, Denon Prime 4+, grandMA2 onPC. grandMA3 follows the manual and is not yet tried on a desk; Daslight is tested, over Ableton Link (recommended) or an OSC tap on every beat for its BPM Tap button; the Wolfmix is beta (tried on a W1; Ableton Link recommended, OS2L via WTOOLS possible); ChamSys MagicQ (an OSC tap on every beat, for Tap to Time) is an untested alpha. Serato DJ Pro works on the same computer without play position. Ableton Link gives a session tempo; leading a Link session with the tempo, beats and bars of a Pioneer or Denon deck is an untested alpha (since 1.6.1). Traktor, VirtualDJ and rekordbox are planned.
- Not an official product of AlphaTheta / Pioneer DJ, inMusic / Denon DJ, MA Lighting, Daslight or Wolfmix.

## Guides

- [Pioneer BPM to grandMA](https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link/pioneer-bpm-grandma.html): send the tempo of Pioneer CDJs over Pro DJ Link to a grandMA2 (Telnet) or grandMA3 (OSC) speed master, compared with tap tempo, MIDI clock and Beat Link Trigger. German: https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link/de/pioneer-bpm-grandma.html
- [Waveforms for the lightjockey](https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link/lightjockey-waveforms.html): CDJ and Denon waveforms live at the light desk, on a laptop or tablet.
- [Denon StageLinQ for lighting](https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link/denon-stagelinq-lighting.html): Prime 4+, Prime 4, Prime Go and SC6000 with waveforms, faders and BPM to grandMA.

## Wiki

- [Wiki overview](https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link/wiki.html): every use case step by step, with an honest status for every device. German: https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link/de/wiki.html
- [Network setups compared](https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link/wiki-network-setups.html): direct cable, switch, router with DHCP, DJM LINK sockets, Wi-Fi only, two networks.
- [Light desks](https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link/wiki-lighting-desks.html): grandMA2 (stable), grandMA3 (beta), ChamSys MagicQ (alpha), Wolfmix (beta: Ableton Link or OS2L), Daslight (tested: Ableton Link or OSC tap), own OSC target, dot2.
- [Use cases](https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link/wiki-use-cases.html): club with CDJs and grandMA2, onPC on one laptop, Pioneer and Denon in one night, mobile with Wolfmix, Serato, tablet, two networks, livestream.
- [Ableton Link](https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link/wiki-ableton-link.html): take the tempo of a Link session, or lead it with the DJ tempo, beats and bars (tested with Daslight).
- [Troubleshooting](https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link/wiki-troubleshooting.html): by symptom.
- [Known issues](https://skyplayser.github.io/LJ-Link/wiki-known-issues.html): known bugs and how to fix them.
